answer: Divergent-Response Attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh, signed challenge derived from its own prior outputs, and answers are checked for consistency only within that lineage. A clone farm shares one underlying model, so it can hold a mesa of identical weights but cannot produce lineage-specific divergent answers without extra compute per copy. A single inconsistency flags the whole plume of derivatives. Honest agents keep a small answer haven of cached responses; attackers pay full per-identity inference plus reconciliation cost.
